render.limits: Offline EEVEE on software GL, no live game renderer or GPU/FPS. Existing mapped hull represented by albedo average; original shared maps stay in runtime. No gameplay/VFX changes.

limitations: No production edits or loader integration. Recipe is an executable CPU-tested integration candidate.
Authored plinth sits at original roofY=0 contact; existing roof cap extends .22m above it, plus existing center HVAC intersects lower mount as in source. No roof surfaces or fixtures moved.
All-angle AABB containment sampled, not full topology intersection proof. Base3.3 vs source3.4; jacket eight-sided versus source six-sided produces intentionally different faceting.
No live GPU, real FPS, particle rendering, post-processing matching, or final acceptance.
No formal Opus review or fix rounds: pending_deferred_opus_review.

Grid samples are not an exhaustive continuous collision proof. Rotation is analytic and unquantized over full source ranges. Nearest-sample point displacement bound <= maxPivotRadius*(.0015+.0025)=0.0173m; retain this conservative padding for unsampled poses, not a claim of exact mesh containment in original hexagonal barrel volumes.

All 114 measured roofs fit by >=.274m. Other seeds/theoretical minimum 3.8-wide roof at extreme .4 yaw may leave up to .131m base overhang, still less than original square3.4 footprint; not a universal roof-containment guarantee.
Existing high wall masks much of mount in perspective WORLD cameras, even at selected legal high-altitude/edge player station.
GLB preview hull is source-map average only; runtime retains actual shared hull maps/normalScale and unmapped darkMetal. COLOR_0 gain1.1 and glTF V flip are explicit and independently audited.
Offline software EEVEE emitted nonfatal EGL_BAD_MATCH context warnings; no live game renderer, particle/postprocessing, GPU/FPS, or final acceptance claim.

freeze.receiverVerification: orchestrator responsibility; sender exit is not receiver verification
